_comment: Music sources for Bouzid FM. FOLDER-DERIVED model: each key below is a music folder name (and MUST match a folder/label in config/schedule_config.py). Crates are AUTO-DISCOVERED at runtime — the weekly scheduler only activates dayparts whose folder actually contains audio on disk (see azuracast.discover_music_crates). So this file no longer gates what's on air; it only feeds `bouzid fetch` / the Music tab when you want to (re)download a folder. 'default' is a researched Anghami playlist URL; 'override' wins when set (edit from the Music tab). To add a brand-new crate: create the folder under MUSIC_DIR, drop audio in, then (optionally) add the folder key here with a source URL. Tracks download as MP3 via yt-dlp YouTube search of the Anghami tracklist. Public Anghami playlists need no login.
